'''Ashizumi Jinja''' (阿志都彌神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} located in the Adogawa-chō area of {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|en|Takashima, Shiga|qid=Q845794|lt=Takashima, Shiga|1=Takashima, Shiga}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|en|Shiga Prefecture|qid=Q131358|lt=Shiga Prefecture|1=Shiga Prefecture}}. It is recognized as a candidate (論社) for one of the ancient {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|2=ja|3=式内社|1=Shikinaisha|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikinaisha|13=User:Immanuelle|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|lt=Shikinaisha}}.
== deity ==
* {{ill|Shima Tsuhiko no Mikoto|ja|島津彦命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shima Tsuhiko no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}
== History ==
The shrine’s founding date is unknown. According to its records, in Meō 2 (1493), the shrine grounds were improved by Sasaki Noto-no-Kami, the lord of {{ill|Funaki Castle|ja|船木城|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Funaki Castle|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. Later, in Kanbun 2 (1662), both the main sanctuary and worship hall were rebuilt. In Meiji 9 (1876), it was classified as a {{ill|Sonsha (village shrine)|ja|村社|1=Son-sha|qid=Q134917284}}{{efn|Former shrine rank|lt=Son-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917284|qq= 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q712534}}.
